bright
adjective us /braɪt/ uk /braɪt/
giving out or reflecting a lot of light:
The room was bright and sunny.
It was a bright sunny day in early spring.
intelligent and quick to learn
She was the brightest student in the class.
He is a bright young man with a future ahead of him.
when you are happy
She looked bright today.
brilliant bright radiant good
bright
adverb
in a way that gives out a lot of light:
The stars shone bright over the desert.
a round of drinks in a pub
